outlet: Walla Walla Union-Bulletin, "Columbia County orchardist settles over Ecology fine" (2016-12-21)
notes: Ecology fined Warren Orchards (Touchet River near Dayton; operator Bill Warren, for his father Robert Warren) $73,530 for diverting river water during the 2015 drought curtailment; settled for $30,000 plus a 20-acre conservation easement for salmon habitat. Identity: the candidate describes himself as a Columbia County farmer and orchardist (pamphlet).
